summaries.Romania: Romania's labor costs are converging with Western Europe while economic sentiment deteriorates, with entrepreneurs warning of recession risks. Meanwhile, nuclear energy projects and gas support schemes remain key government priorities amid energy security concerns.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation faces policy headwinds as Democrats gain leverage post-elections, while measles deaths resurge amid vaccination gaps and healthcare costs continue rising for Medicare beneficiaries.
summaries.Tech: Apple expands AI capabilities across iOS 27.3 with Siri enhancements and new Health app features, while the broader tech industry grapples with AI economics, data center power constraints, and cybersecurity threats highlighted by the massive Binance breach.

items.title: Proiectele nucleare de la Cernavodă și Doicești, discutate de ministrul Energiei cu ambasadorul SUA / ”România urmărește accelerarea proiectelor nucleare”
items.snippet: Ministrul Energiei, Dumitru Chisăliță, a discutat marți cu ambasadorul SUA în România, Darryl Nirenberg, despre dezvoltarea proiectelor nucleare de la Cernavodă și Doicești, consolidarea Coridorului Vertical de Gaze și atragerea de noi investiții americane în sectorul energetic, relatează Mediafax.
items.line: Democrats decisively win Senate and House control in midterms, limiting Trump's legislative agenda and creating leverage over healthcare and economic policy for next two years.

items.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows
items.snippet: The years-long wait for access to the grid and new turbines is causing data center builders to turn to an unusual, less-efficient and less environmentally friendly solution: once-discarded jet engines.
items.line: Data center builders turning to salvaged jet engines due to grid wait times, revealing a critical bottleneck in AI compute expansion and potential environmental/efficiency costs.

items.title: Binance says hackers used fake job interviews and an internal AI tool to pull off the $6.3 billion heist
items.snippet: The largest crypto theft to date was pulled off by combining some well-known hacking techniques over the course of a few months, according to Binance. A postmortem from the company says the process started in June with one developer downloading a tampered installer apparently spread by a malicious G
items.line: $6.3B Binance hack used fake job interviews and compromised internal AI tools, exposing how sophisticated social engineering remains the weakest link in security despite technical defenses.

items.title: Fiecare euro produs de firmele străine în România costă aproape cât în Vest
items.snippet: Între 2021 și 2024, costul muncii a crescut în România mai repede decât valoarea produsă de un angajat, iar ritmul acestei creșteri a fost cel mai mare dintre cele cinci economii din regiune analizate. Un studiu Consilium Policy Advisors Group (CPAG) arată că prima etapă a convergenței s-a încheiat.
items.line: Romania's wage growth now outpaces productivity gains faster than peer nations, signaling the end of cheap labor advantage and convergence toward Western costs.

items.line: US and Romania accelerate nuclear projects at Cernavodă and Doicești while discussing strategic energy cooperation, positioning nuclear as critical to European security.

items.title: STAT+: Democrats win power to push back on Trump’s health care moves
items.snippet: Democrats win Senate control, and with it the power to push back on Trump’s health care moves.
items.line: Democratic Senate control enables pushback against Trump's healthcare agenda, potentially preserving Medicaid expansion and ACA protections for next two years.

items.title: Medicare Part D premiums projected to rise 50% in 2027 without plan switching: KFF
items.snippet: Medicare beneficiaries who stay in their current stand-alone Part D plans could face sharply higher premiums, deductibles and other out-of-pocket costs in 2027, a KFF analysis found.
items.line: Medicare Part D premiums projected to spike 50% in 2027 without plan switching, creating affordability crisis for retirees and political pressure on both parties.

items.line: iOS 27.3 dramatically expands Siri AI capabilities across Apple apps and introduces developer 'app skills,' marking the first meaningful step toward practical AI assistant functionality.

items.title: Anthropic is still grappling with the economics of compute
items.snippet: At a moment when Anthropic's compute margins should be getting better, they’re getting worse.
items.line: Anthropic's compute margins worsening despite scale improvements, signaling that AI inference economics remain structurally challenged and unsustainable at current pricing.
